decision: Require complete old ordered rows as literal prefix of each decisions/contributions/aliases history, and test decoded history independently of packed dictionary slot numbering.
reason: Prior identity-map preservation accepted reorderings and insertion. Appending repeated payloads can also reindex the existing codec dictionary while the source history remains an exact prefix.
actual_checked_contracts: checkPrefix = true iff newRows = oldRows ++ tail for an actual ordered suffix.
checkDecodedExtension = true iff actual unpack succeeds with oldRows ++ tail.
Positions and mapped key order preserved; accepted prefixes compose; fresh pack append accepted.
Checked concrete stale-slot example [7,8] -> [8,7] decodes wrong old payloads even though all references stay in bounds.
operational_obligations: Strict input schema validation precedes complete row prefix equality.
Numeric and boolean values are rejected from these typed history fields; no arbitrary JSON equality claim.

No authenticated hash history, global agreement, SHA injectivity, or filesystem durability theorem.
Prefix-tree/DAG mapping and incremental slot-stable packing remain future work.
